title: Pro-etale component test object and its ambient inclusion
statement: Let $X,Y$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $j:Y\to X$ a morphism. For an object $H\to X$ of the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], define the component test object $H_Y$ to be the fibre product $H\times_XY$ [def-pc-fibre-product], with its second projection to $Y$, as an object of $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$. If $j$ is an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], regard $H_Y$ as an object of $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ by composition with $j$. Define its ambient inclusion $H_Y\to H$ to be the first fibre-product projection, with its morphism-over-$X$ structure given by the pullback commutativity equation. These constructions apply in particular to a clopen component; no closedness assumption is needed.
